Population of four European countries by age group and sex

Source: R/data.R
europe_pop.Rd

The population on 1 January 2004 and 2024 of France, Ireland, Italy and Poland, by five-year age group and sex, from Eurostat. It is included for examples and has the shape most population data come in: one row per country, year, age group and sex.

Usage

europe_pop

Format

A data frame with 288 rows and 5 columns:

country

Country, a factor.

year

Year of the population count, 2004 or 2024.

age

Age group, a factor from "0-4" to "85+" in ascending order.

sex

Sex, a factor with levels "Male" and "Female".

population

Number of people.

Source

Eurostat, "Population on 1 January by age group and sex" (demo_pjangroup), https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/databrowser/view/demo_pjangroup, retrieved 25 October 2026 and reused under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence. Some 2024 figures are provisional.

Examples

library(ggplot2)

ggplot(europe_pop, aes(x = population, y = age, fill = sex)) +
  geom_pyramid(denominator = "total") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent()) +
  coord_pyramid() +
  facet_grid(year ~ country)
